shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin recently dipped below $59,000, and the Crypto Fear & Greed Index indicates extreme fear at 11.
US Federal Reserve comments on July 1st eased inflation concerns, leading to a slight rebound in crypto and broader risk assets.
The EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework entered full enforcement on July 1, impacting crypto firms operating in the Eurozone.
The US CLARITY Act, a key crypto regulatory bill, is likely facing delays in the Senate, extending market uncertainty.
Ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East continue to weigh on overall market sentiment and risk appetite.
